description: This Java class provides a configurable wrapper around debug and logging functionality using Log4j. It supports various logging levels, retrieving log settings from properties, and offers convenience methods for different severity levels. The class centralizes debug logging control within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A final class providing static methods for flexible debug and log level control within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getLevelFromString
methods.description: Converts a string level name to its corresponding integer level constant.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with optional exception at a specified level and module.

methods.name: isOn
methods.description: Checks if a specific log level is enabled.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific logging level.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns whether a specific log level is currently enabled.
